statement: ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → Odd n → ∃ p q r : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ Nat.Prime r ∧ p + q + r = n

plain_statement.en: Every sufficiently large odd integer is a sum of three primes.
plain_statement.zh: 每个充分大的奇数都可以表示为三个素数之和。

brief.en: A positive lower bound for the ternary Fourier coefficient gives a positive term in the prime-log triple convolution and hence three prime summands.
brief.zh: 三元傅里叶系数的正下界保证素数对数三重卷积中有正项，从而给出三个素数加数。
